reader_question: Where did federal spending go in fiscal 2026?
grade_line: Documented: the Treasury’s monthly statement of federal accounts
title: Social Security was the largest budget function in fiscal 2026, at $1,667.1 billion of $7,395.8 billion in net federal outlays.
measure_line: Net federal outlays by budget function, billions of dollars, fiscal 2026 (October 2025 to September 2026), United States.
notes: Net outlays subtract offsetting receipts, so two lines are negative: Undistributed Offsetting Receipts and Commerce and Housing Credit.
Functions group spending by purpose, not by agency.
source_line: Source: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Monthly Treasury Statement, Table 9, outlays by function, fiscal 2026, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Net outlays in nominal dollars; offsetting receipts are shown as negative.
alt: Ranked bars of net federal outlays in fiscal 2026 by budget function. Social Security leads at $1,667.1 billion, followed by Medicare, net interest, health and national defense, each near $1 trillion.
